name: AuroraHeadline
description: High-contrast display headline combining masked word entrances, flowing spectral gradient illumination, and graceful static fallback.
a11yNotes: Maintains WCAG AAA foreground contrast with solid silver fallback text and disables gradient sweep and vertical motion under prefers-reduced-motion.

defaultProps.text: Restrained spectral illumination for engineering headlines

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Headline string to reveal and illuminate.

propsApi.name: shimmerSpeed
propsApi.description: Duration in seconds for one gradient sweep.

propsApi.name: stagger
propsApi.description: Delay in seconds between sequential word reveals.
